title: Tower of London virtual tour written guide
subject: History
unit: Spring 2: Medieval monarchs: Magna Carta and Edward I
source: Written for history/y7 lesson 14 (Tower of London virtual tour written guide (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 14: Site study: the Tower of London. Read it all first; an adult knows what you are doing.

practical.aim: To explore the Tower of London on a virtual tour and find evidence
equipment: A device with the portal link to the virtual tour
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Tidy up and wash your hands
method: Open the tour with an adult's permission
Find the White Tower: who built it and when?
Find two features that made it strong
Find one way it was used later
Record each fact with where you found it
Decide what the Tower tells us about Norman power

questions.q: Big question: why would a castle keep changing?
questions.a: New threats, new technology, and rulers wanting to show power
